rationale: C12 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both directives transmit a commission report, characterize it as a basis for further policy development, instruct responsible executive agencies to undertake an intensive or detailed review, anticipate coordinated recommendations or a unified program, and connect the resulting action to Congress and the economic strength of the United States and the free world. C19 and C04 are closely connected to the same foreign-economic-policy process, but neither parallels the child's report-transmission and agency-review machinery as fully as C12.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WITH THIS MEMORANDUM, I am transmitting a copy of the Report to the President and the Congress by the Commission on Foreign Economic Policy.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am transmitting to the Congress the report of the President's Materials Policy Commission, "Resources for freedom."
shared_material.explanation: Both open by transmitting a presidential commission's completed report to Congress.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Executive Departments and Agencies with responsibilities in the area of foreign economic policy proceed immediately with an intensive review of this report
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am requesting the various Government agencies to make a detailed study of these recommendations
shared_material.explanation: This is the same material administrative mechanism: responsible agencies are directed to review a commission report in detail.

shared_material.child_excerpt: as a first step in the formulation of a unified Administration program to be submitted to the Congress
shared_material.parent_excerpt: directing the National Security Resources Board to assume the responsibility of coordinating the findings... appropriate recommendations will be made to the Congress
shared_material.explanation: Both move from agency study through executive coordination to proposed congressional action.

shared_material.child_excerpt: advance the best interests both of the United States and of the free world
shared_material.parent_excerpt: contribute significantly to the improvement of this Nation's materials position and to the strengthening of the free world's economic security
shared_material.explanation: The concluding policy justification uses a closely parallel United States/free-world formulation.
